<script>
  // Heatmap overlay loader. Three gates, all of them cheap, none of them trusting the URL:
  // the visitor must have arrived on a pf_heatmap link, the SERVER must have published an
  // overlay path in the metafield, and this page must already be one the merchant enabled
  // tracking for. The last gate is what stops a crafted link pulling the asset onto an
  // arbitrary storefront page. Everything else is decided inside the asset, and by the server.
  (function () {
    var cfg = window.__pagefly_heatmap_config__ || {}
    var id = (window.__pagefly_page_setting__ || {}).pageId
    if (!/[#&]pf_heatmap=/.test(window.location.hash || '')) return
    if (!cfg.overlay_data_path || !Array.isArray(cfg.enabled_page_ids)) return
    if (!id || cfg.enabled_page_ids.indexOf(id) === -1) return
    var s = document.createElement('script')
    s.src = 'https://cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a14d28-8813-7769-97df-ce8ba6122f78/pagefly-ai-page-builder-373/assets/pagefly-heatmap-overlay.js'
    s.defer = true
    document.head.appendChild(s)
  })()
</script>

<script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "http://schema.org",
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Albert Levi LLC",
    
      "logo": "https:\/\/www.albertlevi.com\/cdn\/shop\/files\/FINAL_LOGO_RESPONSIVE-2.png?v=1711030130\u0026width=500",
    
    "sameAs": [
      "#",
      "https:\/\/www.facebook.com\/profile.php?id=100086730423083\u0026mibextid=LQQJ4d",
      "",
      "https:\/\/instagram.com\/albert.art5?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      ""
    ],
    "url": "https:\/\/www.albertlevi.com"
  }
</script><script>
(function () {
  var DEBUG = true;
  var UTM_KEYS    = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
  var STORAGE_KEY = '_saved_utms';
  var MAX_AGE_DAYS = 30;

  function captureUtms() {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var found = {}, hasAny = false;
    UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) {
      var v = params.get(k);
      if (v) { found[k] = v; hasAny = true; }
    });
    if (!hasAny) return;
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ data: found, ts: Date.now() })); } catch (e) {}
    setCookie(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(found), MAX_AGE_DAYS);
    if (DEBUG) console.log('[UTM] captured:', found);
  }

  function getStoredUtms() {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        var p = JSON.parse(raw);
        if ((Date.now() - p.ts) / 86400000 <= MAX_AGE_DAYS) return p.data;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    var c = getCookie(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (c) { try { return JSON.parse(c); } catch (e) {} }
    return {};
  }

  function setCookie(name, value, days) {
    var d = new Date();
    d.setTime(d.getTime() + days * 86400000);
    document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + ';expires=' + d.toUTCString() + ';path=/;SameSite=Lax';
  }
  function getCookie(name) {
    var m = document.cookie.match('(?:^|; )' + name + '=([^;]*)');
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
  }

  // Put stored UTMs back into the URL so Globo'sreads them.
  function restoreUtmsToUrl() {
    var utms = getStoredUtms();
    if (!Object.keys(utms).length) return;
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var changed = false;
    UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) {
      if (utms[k] && !params.get(k)) { params.set(k, utms[k]); changed = true; }
    });
    if (changed) {
      var newUrl = window.location.pathname + '?' + params.toString() + window.location.hash;
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
      if (DEBUG) console.log('[UTM] restored to URL:', params.toString());
    }
  }

  // Run capture + restore as early as possible, before the form app initializes.
  captureUtms();
  restoreUtmsToUrl();
})();
</script>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      // Choose Product radios (Option position 1)
      const chooseProductRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][data-option-position="1"]');

      // Frame Color radios (Option position 3) ✅ IMPORTANT FIX
      const frameRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][data-option-position="3"]');

      // Wrapper fieldset for Frame Color
      const frameWrapper = document.querySelector('.Variant_Frame_Color');

      // Helper: show/hide a radio + its label
      function toggleRadio(radio, show) {
        const label = document.querySelector(`label[for="${radio.id}"]`);
        if (show) {
          radio.style.display = '';
          if (label) label.style.display = '';
        } else {
          radio.style.display = 'none';
          if (label) label.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }

      // Helper: select a specific frame value (and trigger change so Shopify updates variant)
      function selectFrame(value) {
        let matched = false;

        frameRadios.forEach((radio) => {
          const v = radio.dataset.optionValue || radio.value;
          if (v === value) {
            radio.checked = true;
            matched = true;
            radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });

        return matched;
      }

      // Main function: apply rules based on selected Choose Product
      function applyFrameRules() {
        const selectedProduct = document.querySelector('input[type="radio"][data-option-position="1"]:checked');

        if (!selectedProduct) return;

        const selectedValue = selectedProduct.dataset.optionValue || selectedProduct.value;

        // CASE 1: Canvas Art => only Stretch Frame, hide Frame Color block
        if (selectedValue === 'Canvas Art') {
          frameRadios.forEach((r) => {
            const v = r.dataset.optionValue || r.value;
            if (v === 'Stretch Frame') toggleRadio(r, true);
            else toggleRadio(r, false);
          });

          if (frameWrapper) frameWrapper.style.display = 'none';

          // Select default
          selectFrame('Stretch Frame');
        }

        // CASE 2: Floating Framed Canvas => only Black/White, show Frame Color block
        else if (selectedValue === 'Floating Framed Canvas') {
          frameRadios.forEach((r) => {
            const v = r.dataset.optionValue || r.value;
            if (v === 'Black Frame' || v === 'White Frame') toggleRadio(r, true);
            else toggleRadio(r, false);
          });

          if (frameWrapper) frameWrapper.style.display = 'flex';

          // Select default Black first; if not found then White
          if (!selectFrame('Black Frame')) {
            selectFrame('White Frame');
          }
        }

        // OPTIONAL: if future product types added, just show everything
        else {
          frameRadios.forEach((r) => toggleRadio(r, true));
          if (frameWrapper) frameWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
        }
      }

      let syncingRolledCanvas = false;

      function isRolledCanvas(value) {
        return value === 'Rolled Canvas' || value === 'Rolled';
      }

      function isEmbellishedProduct(value) {
        return value === 'Embellished' || value === 'Hand Enhanced';
      }

      // Rolled Canvas is the only Choose Frame value this rule hides.
      // Every other option keeps the disabled state from real availability.
      function applyRolledCanvasVisibility(root) {
        const scope = root || document;
        const productInput = scope.querySelector('.Variant_Choose_Product input[type="radio"]:checked');
        const frameInputs = [...scope.querySelectorAll('.Variant_Choose_Frame input[type="radio"]')];
        if (!productInput || !frameInputs.length) return;

        const selectedProduct = (productInput.dataset.optionValue || productInput.value || '').trim();
        const embellishedSelected = isEmbellishedProduct(selectedProduct);

        frameInputs.forEach((radio) => {
          const value = (radio.dataset.optionValue || radio.value || '').trim();
          if (!isRolledCanvas(value)) return;
          radio.classList.toggle('disabled', !embellishedSelected);
        });

        if (syncingRolledCanvas) return;

        const checkedFrame = frameInputs.find((radio) => radio.checked);
        if (!checkedFrame || !checkedFrame.classList.contains('disabled')) return;

        const nextFrame = frameInputs.find((radio) => !radio.classList.contains('disabled'));
        if (!nextFrame) return;

        syncingRolledCanvas = true;
        nextFrame.checked = true;
        nextFrame.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        syncingRolledCanvas = false;
        applyRolledCanvasVisibility(scope);
      }

      // Listen for Choose Product changes
      chooseProductRadios.forEach((radio) => {
        radio.addEventListener('change', applyFrameRules);
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios').forEach((picker) => {
        picker.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
          if (!event.target.matches('input[type="radio"]')) return;
          applyRolledCanvasVisibility(picker);
        });
      });

      // Run once on page load (important when default is pre-selected)
      applyFrameRules();
      applyRolledCanvasVisibility();
    });
  </script>

<script>
  (function() {
    const displayOn = "all_devices" || 'all_devices';

    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
    let shouldDisplay = true;
    if (displayOn === 'mobile_only' && !isMobile) {
      shouldDisplay = false;
    } else if (displayOn === 'desktop_only' && isMobile) {
      shouldDisplay = false;
    }

    const pictureItThemeAppExtensionArButtonEL = document.querySelector(
      "#picture-it-theme-app-extension-ar-button",
    );
    const triggers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-picture-it-trigger]");

    if (!shouldDisplay) {
      if (pictureItThemeAppExtensionArButtonEL) {
        pictureItThemeAppExtensionArButtonEL.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
      }
      if (triggers && triggers.length > 0) {
        triggers.forEach(trigger => {
          trigger.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }

      return;
    }
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function(){
    function createHideWrapper() {
      let hideWrapper = document.createElement("picture-it-hide-wrapper");
      hideWrapper.style.display = "none";
      return hideWrapper;
    }

    function appendMedia(hideWrapper, replacePart) {
      const appendNode = (node) => {
        if (!node) return false;
        if (hideWrapper.contains(node)) return true;

        node.parentNode.insertBefore(hideWrapper, node);
        hideWrapper.appendChild(node);
        return true;
      };

      const getMediaGallery = () =>
        document.querySelector("media-gallery");

      const getMainImage = () =>
        document.querySelector(".product__media-item.is-active img") ||
        document.querySelector(".media-gallery__grid li:first-child img") ||
        document.querySelector(".media-gallery__grid img");

      const handleToggleBtn = () => {
      const toggleBtn =
        document.querySelector(".product__media-item.is-active .product__media-toggle") ||
        document.querySelector(".product-media-container__zoom-button");
        if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.style.display = "none";
      };

      if (replacePart === "media_gallery") {
        const appended = appendNode(getMediaGallery());

        if (!appended) {
          if (appendNode(getMainImage())) {
            handleToggleBtn();
          }
        }
        return;
      }

      const appended = appendNode(getMainImage());

      if (appended) {
        handleToggleBtn();
      } else {
        appendNode(getMediaGallery());
      }
    }

    const displayMode =
      "popup";
    const replacePart =
      "main_image";
    const isArPreviewOnly =
      "ar_preview_only" === "ar_preview_only";
    const ArPreviewOnly = "ar_preview_only";

    if (displayMode === "replace_image" && !isArPreviewOnly) {
      const hideWrapper =
        document.querySelector("picture-it-hide-wrapper") ||
        createHideWrapper();

      appendMedia(hideWrapper, replacePart);
    }
  })();
</script>

      <script>
        (function () {
          var picker = document.getElementById('variant-radios-template--22864827679028__main');
          if (!picker || picker.dataset.sizeChartReady === 'true') return;
          picker.dataset.sizeChartReady = 'true';
          var modal = document.getElementById('SizeChartModal-template--22864827679028__main');
          if (!modal) return;
          if (modal.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(modal);
          var image = modal.querySelector('.size-chart-modal__image');
          var switcher = modal.querySelector('.size-chart-modal__switch');
          var charts = {
            canvas: picker.dataset.canvasChart || '',
            embellished: picker.dataset.embellishedChart || '',
          };

          function selectedProduct() {
            var input = picker.querySelector('[data-option-position="1"]:checked');
            return ((input && (input.dataset.optionValue || input.value)) || '').toLowerCase();
          }

          function showChart(which) {
            var src = charts[which] || charts.canvas || charts.embellished;
            if (!src) return;
            image.src = src;
            switcher.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (button) {
              button.classList.toggle('is-active', button.dataset.chart === which && charts[button.dataset.chart]);
            });
          }

          function openChart() {
            if (!charts.canvas && !charts.embellished) return;
            var embellished = /embellish|hand enhanced/.test(selectedProduct());
            if (charts.canvas && charts.embellished) {
              switcher.hidden = false;
              showChart(embellished ? 'embellished' : 'canvas');
            } else {
              switcher.hidden = true;
              showChart(charts.embellished && !charts.canvas ? 'embellished' : 'canvas');
            }
            modal.hidden = false;
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
          }

          function closeChart() {
            modal.hidden = true;
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
          }

          picker.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            if (!event.target.closest('.size-chart-icon')) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            openChart();
          });
          modal.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            if (event.target.closest('[data-size-chart-close]')) closeChart();
            var chartButton = event.target.closest('[data-chart]');
            if (chartButton) showChart(chartButton.dataset.chart);
          });
          document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) closeChart();
          });
        })();
      </script>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Unique selectors using Liquid section.id to avoid conflicts
    var sliderSelector = '.frame-color-slider-template--22864827679028__main';
    var paginationSelector = '.frame-color-pagination-template--22864827679028__main';

    // Helper to load script or css only if not present
    function loadScript(url, cb) {
      if (document.querySelector('script[src="' + url + '"]')) {
        return cb();
      }
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = url;
      s.async = false;
      s.onload = cb;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }
    function loadCss(url) {
      if (document.querySelector('link[href="' + url + '"]')) return;
      var l = document.createElement('link');
      l.rel = 'stylesheet';
      l.href = url;
      document.head.appendChild(l);
    }

    // CDN URLs (Swiper v9+ compatible)
    var SWIPER_CSS = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css';
    var SWIPER_JS = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js';

    // Ensure DOM ready
    function onDomReady(fn) {
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
      } else {
        fn();
      }
    }

    onDomReady(function () {
      var sliderEl = document.querySelector(sliderSelector);
      if (!sliderEl) return; // nothing to do

      // Load CSS & JS if missing
      loadCss(SWIPER_CSS);
      loadScript(SWIPER_JS, function () {
        // Wait until Swiper is available
        var tryInit = function () {
          if (typeof Swiper === 'undefined') {
            setTimeout(tryInit, 50);
            return;
          }

          // ensure each label inside wrapper is a swiper-slide (no change to inner inputs)
          var wrapper = sliderEl.querySelector('.frame-color-group');
          if (!wrapper) return;
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrapper.children, function (ch) {
            if (ch.classList && !ch.classList.contains('swiper-slide')) {
              ch.classList.add('swiper-slide');
            }
          });

          // If hidden inputs are used by your other scripts, ensure they exist
          if (!document.getElementById('hidden-frame-style')) {
            var hs = document.createElement('input');
            hs.type = 'hidden';
            hs.id = 'hidden-frame-style';
            hs.name = 'hidden-frame-style';
            hs.value = '';
            sliderEl.appendChild(hs);
          }
          if (!document.getElementById('hidden-frame-color')) {
            var hc = document.createElement('input');
            hc.type = 'hidden';
            hc.id = 'hidden-frame-color';
            hc.name = 'hidden-frame-color';
            hc.value = '';
            sliderEl.appendChild(hc);
          }

          // Initialize Swiper with responsive slidesPerView
          var swiper = new Swiper(sliderSelector, {
            modules: window.Swiper && window.Swiper.modules ? window.Swiper.modules : undefined,
            slidesPerView: 4,
            spaceBetween: 8,
            pagination: {
              el: paginationSelector,
              clickable: true,
            },
            breakpoints: {
              0: { slidesPerView: 3.2 },
              420: { slidesPerView: 4.2 },
              640: { slidesPerView: 5 },
              1024: { slidesPerView: 6 },
            },
            // keep swiping smooth and not intercept clicks on labels
            touchStartPreventDefault: false,
            watchSlidesProgress: true,
          });

          // Ensure when a slide's radio input changes, we update active classes (preserve your behavior)
          wrapper.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (input) {
            input.addEventListener(
              'change',
              function (ev) {
                // find label and add active class, remove from others
                var lbl = input.closest('.frame-color-btn');
                if (!lbl) return;
                wrapper.querySelectorAll('.frame-color-btn').forEach(function (l) {
                  l.classList.remove('active');
                });
                lbl.classList.add('active');

                // update hidden inputs if exist
                var style = document.querySelector('input[name="properties[Frame Style]"]:checked');
                var hiddenStyle = document.getElementById('hidden-frame-style');
                var hiddenColor = document.getElementById('hidden-frame-color');
                if (hiddenStyle && style) hiddenStyle.value = style.value;
                if (hiddenColor) hiddenColor.value = input.value;
              },
              false
            );
          });

          // When style changes, trigger a re-check (preserve your existing style change logic)
          document.querySelectorAll('input[name="properties[Frame Style]"]').forEach(function (r) {
            r.addEventListener('change', function () {
              // run the same logic your original script expects (if present)
              var evt = new Event('change', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
              // trigger click on the currently checked color to force update (if any)
              var currentColor = wrapper.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
              if (currentColor) currentColor.dispatchEvent(evt);
            });
          });
        }; // tryInit

        tryInit();
      }); // loadScript
    }); // dom ready
  })();
</script>

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const openBtn = document.getElementById("open-product-guide");
        const modal = document.getElementById("product-guide-modal");
        const closeBtn = document.getElementById("close-product-guide");

        if (openBtn && modal && closeBtn) {
          openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            modal.classList.remove("hidden");
            document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
          });

          closeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            modal.classList.add("hidden");
            document.body.style.overflow = "";
          });

          modal.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) {
              modal.classList.add("hidden");
              document.body.style.overflow = "";
            }
          });
        }
      });
    

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      function isIE() {
        const ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
        const msie = ua.indexOf('MSIE ');
        const trident = ua.indexOf('Trident/');

        return msie > 0 || trident > 0;
      }

<script>
  (function () {
    function relocatePictureItButton() {
      // Find the Picture It button or its elements
      const btn = document.querySelector(
        '#picture-it-theme-app-extension-ar-button, .picture-it-theme-app-extension-ar-button, [id*="picture-it-theme-app-extension-ar-button"], [class*="picture-it-theme-app-extension-ar-button"]'
      );

      if (!btn) return;

      const isMobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches;

      let target = null;
      if (isMobile) {
        // Mobile: target container below thumbnail slider
        target =
          document.querySelector('#vtg-template--22864827679028__main .picture-it-ar-mobile-container') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper .picture-it-ar-mobile-container') ||
          document.querySelector('#vtg-template--22864827679028__main') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper media-gallery') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper');
      } else {
        // Desktop: target container on the featured image
        target =
          document.querySelector('#vtg-template--22864827679028__main .picture-it-ar-featured-container') ||
          document.querySelector('#vtg-template--22864827679028__main .vtg-bottom-actions') ||
          document.querySelector('#vtg-template--22864827679028__main .vtg-main-wrapper') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper .picture-it-ar-featured-container') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper slider-component') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper media-gallery') ||
          document.querySelector('.product__media-wrapper');
      }

      if (!target) return;

      // Check if button is already inside target
      if (target.contains(btn)) return;

      // Check if inside product-info container
      const productInfo = btn.closest('.product__info-container, .product__info-wrapper, product-info');
      const appBlock = btn.closest('.shopify-app-block, [id*="shopify-block-picture_it"], [class*="picture_it_live_preview_block"]');

      // Move element to appropriate container
      const elToMove = (appBlock && productInfo && appBlock.querySelectorAll('*').length <= 6) ? appBlock : btn;
      target.appendChild(elToMove);

      if (target.classList.contains('picture-it-ar-featured-container') || target.classList.contains('picture-it-ar-mobile-container') || target.classList.contains('vtg-bottom-actions')) {
        target.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', relocatePictureItButton);
    } else {
      relocatePictureItButton();
    }

    window.addEventListener('load', relocatePictureItButton);
    window.addEventListener('resize', relocatePictureItButton);

    const mql = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
    if (mql.addEventListener) {
      mql.addEventListener('change', relocatePictureItButton);
    } else if (mql.addListener) {
      mql.addListener(relocatePictureItButton);
    }

    // Watch for dynamic loading / re-renders
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      relocatePictureItButton();
    });

    if (document.body) {
      observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });
    }

    setTimeout(relocatePictureItButton, 200);
    setTimeout(relocatePictureItButton, 600);
    setTimeout(relocatePictureItButton, 1200);
    setTimeout(relocatePictureItButton, 2500);
  })();
</script>

</section>

<script>
  function movePaymentIcon() {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector('more-payment-options-link');
    const icon = document.querySelector('.payment_icon');
    if (wrapper && icon) {
      wrapper.appendChild(icon);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    if (!movePaymentIcon()) {
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (movePaymentIcon()) clearInterval(interval);
      }, 300);
    }
  });

  /* Accordion script */

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const header = e.target.closest('.pdp-accordion-header');
    if (!header) return;

    const currentItem = header.closest('.pdp-accordion-item');
    const currentContent = currentItem.querySelector('.pdp-accordion-content');
    const isActive = currentItem.classList.contains('active');

    document.querySelectorAll('.pdp-accordion-item.active').forEach((item) => {
      if (item !== currentItem) {
        item.classList.remove('active');
        item.querySelector('.pdp-accordion-content').style.maxHeight = null;
      }
    });

    if (isActive) {
      currentItem.classList.remove('active');
      currentContent.style.maxHeight = null;
    } else {
      currentItem.classList.add('active');
      currentContent.style.maxHeight = currentContent.scrollHeight + 'px';
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pdp-accordion-item.active').forEach((item) => {
      const content = item.querySelector('.pdp-accordion-content');
      content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + 'px';
    });
  });
</script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const embellishedText = document.querySelector('.embellished-text');
    if (!embellishedText) return;

    function isHandEmbellished(value) {
      const text = (value || '').toLowerCase();
      return text.includes('embellish') || text.includes('hand enhanced');
    }

    function toggleEmbellishedText() {
      const checkedOptions = document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios input[type="radio"]:checked');
      let showNote = false;

      checkedOptions.forEach((input) => {
        const value = input.dataset.optionValue || input.value || '';
        if (isHandEmbellished(value)) showNote = true;
      });

      embellishedText.classList.toggle('is-visible', showNote);
    }

    toggleEmbellishedText();

    document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios').forEach((picker) => {
      picker.addEventListener('change', toggleEmbellishedText);
    });
  });
</script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios').forEach((picker) => {
      const priceNode = picker.querySelector('[data-variant-formatted-prices]');
      let formattedPrices = {};
      if (priceNode) {
        try {
          formattedPrices = JSON.parse(priceNode.textContent);
        } catch (error) {
          formattedPrices = {};
        }
      }

      function optionValue(input) {
        return ((input && (input.dataset.optionValue || input.value)) || '').trim();
      }

      const moneyFormat = picker.dataset.moneyFormat || '$' + '{' + '{amount}}';

      function formatWithDelimiters(number, precision, thousands, decimal) {
        precision = precision == null ? 2 : precision;
        thousands = thousands || ',';
        decimal = decimal || '.';
        const fixed = (number / 100).toFixed(precision);
        const parts = fixed.split('.');
        const dollars = parts[0].replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d\d)+(?!\d))/g, '$1' + thousands);
        return parts[1] ? dollars + decimal + parts[1] : dollars;
      }

      function formatMoney(cents, format) {
        const placeholder = /\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}/;
        const token = (format.match(placeholder) || [])[1] || 'amount';
        let value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2);
        if (token === 'amount_no_decimals') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0);
        if (token === 'amount_with_comma_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2, '.', ',');
        if (token === 'amount_no_decimals_with_comma_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0, '.', ',');
        if (token === 'amount_with_apostrophe_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2, "'", '.');
        return format.replace(placeholder, value);
      }

      function formatAddon(cents) {
        const sign = cents < 0 ? '-' : '+';
        return sign + formatMoney(Math.abs(Math.round(cents)), moneyFormat);
      }

      function syncFrameAddons(variants, productType, selectedSize) {
        const frameInputs = [...picker.querySelectorAll('.Variant_Choose_Frame input[type="radio"]')];
        if (!frameInputs.length || !productType || !selectedSize) return;

        const matches = variants.filter(
          (variant) => variant.option1 === productType && variant.option2 === selectedSize
        );
        const byFrame = {};
        matches.forEach((variant) => {
          byFrame[(variant.option3 || '').toLowerCase()] = variant;
        });
        const base =
          byFrame['stretch canvas'] ||
          byFrame['stretched canvas'] ||
          byFrame['rolled canvas'] ||
          byFrame['no frame'] ||
          matches.slice().sort((a, b) => Number(a.price) - Number(b.price))[0];
        const basePrice = base ? Number(base.price) : 0;

        frameInputs.forEach((input) => {
          const match = byFrame[optionValue(input).toLowerCase()];
          input.classList.toggle('disabled', !match || match.available === false);
          const label = picker.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(input.id)}"]`);
          if (!label) return;
          let priceEl = label.querySelector('.variant-price');
          if (!match) {
            if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = '';
            return;
          }
          if (!priceEl) {
            priceEl = document.createElement('span');
            priceEl.className = 'variant-price variant-price--addon';
            const text = label.querySelector('.variant-label-text');
            if (text) text.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', priceEl);
            else label.appendChild(priceEl);
          }
          const fullText = formattedPrices[match.id] || formattedPrices[String(match.id)];
          const baseText = base && (formattedPrices[base.id] || formattedPrices[String(base.id)]);
          if (fullText && baseText) {
            const toNumber = (text) => {
              const cleaned = String(text).replace(/[^0-9,.-]/g, '');
              const lastComma = cleaned.lastIndexOf(',');
              const lastDot = cleaned.lastIndexOf('.');
              const normalized =
                lastComma > lastDot ? cleaned.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.') : cleaned.replace(/,/g, '');
              return parseFloat(normalized) || 0;
            };
            const delta = toNumber(fullText) - toNumber(baseText);
            const sign = delta < 0 ? '-' : '+';
            const amount = Math.abs(delta).toLocaleString('en-US', {
              minimumFractionDigits: 2,
              maximumFractionDigits: 2,
            });
            const prefix = (String(fullText).match(/^[^\d-]*/) || [''])[0];
            const currency = (String(fullText).match(/[A-Za-z]{3}\s*$/) || [''])[0].trim();
            priceEl.textContent = sign + prefix + amount + (currency ? ' ' + currency : '');
          } else {
            priceEl.textContent = formatAddon(Number(match.price) - basePrice);
          }
        });
      }

      function syncSizes() {
        const variantNode = picker.querySelector(
          'script[type="application/json"]:not([data-variant-formatted-prices])'
        );
        if (!variantNode) return;

        let variants = [];
        try {
          variants = JSON.parse(variantNode.textContent);
        } catch (error) {
          return;
        }

        const productType = optionValue(
          picker.querySelector(
            '.Variant_Choose_Product input[type="radio"]:checked, [data-option-position="1"]:checked'
          )
        );
        const frame = optionValue(
          picker.querySelector('.Variant_Choose_Frame input[type="radio"]:checked, [data-option-position="3"]:checked')
        );
        const sizeInputs = [...picker.querySelectorAll('.Variant_Choose_Size input[type="radio"]')];
        if (!productType || !sizeInputs.length) return;

        sizeInputs.forEach((input) => {
          const size = optionValue(input);
          const matches = variants.filter(
            (variant) => variant.available && variant.option1 === productType && variant.option2 === size
          );
          input.classList.toggle('disabled', matches.length === 0);

          const label = picker.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(input.id)}"]`);
          if (!label || !matches.length) return;

          const exact = matches.find((variant) => variant.option3 === frame) || matches[0];
          let priceEl = label.querySelector('.variant-price');
          if (!priceEl) {
            priceEl = document.createElement('span');
            priceEl.className = 'variant-price';
            label.appendChild(priceEl);
          }
          if (formattedPrices[exact.id] || formattedPrices[String(exact.id)]) {
            priceEl.textContent = formattedPrices[exact.id] || formattedPrices[String(exact.id)];
          }
        });

        const checkedSize = sizeInputs.find((input) => input.checked);
        syncFrameAddons(variants, productType, optionValue(checkedSize));

        if (picker.dataset.syncingSizes === 'true') return;

        const checked = sizeInputs.find((input) => input.checked);
        if (!checked || !checked.classList.contains('disabled')) return;

        const next = sizeInputs.find((input) => !input.classList.contains('disabled'));
        if (!next) return;

        picker.dataset.syncingSizes = 'true';
        next.checked = true;
        next.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        picker.dataset.syncingSizes = 'false';
      }

      syncSizes();
      picker.addEventListener('change', syncSizes);
    });
  });
</script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const support = document.querySelector('.ptsd-support');
    const amount = support && support.querySelector('[data-ptsd-amount]');
    if (!support || !amount) return;

    const moneyFormat = support.dataset.moneyFormat || '$' + '{' + '{amount}}';

    function formatWithDelimiters(number, precision, thousands, decimal) {
      precision = precision == null ? 2 : precision;
      thousands = thousands || ',';
      decimal = decimal || '.';
      const fixed = (number / 100).toFixed(precision);
      const parts = fixed.split('.');
      const dollars = parts[0].replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d\d)+(?!\d))/g, '$1' + thousands);
      return parts[1] ? dollars + decimal + parts[1] : dollars;
    }

    function formatMoney(cents, format) {
      const placeholder = /\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}/;
      const token = (format.match(placeholder) || [])[1] || 'amount';
      let value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2);
      if (token === 'amount_no_decimals') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0);
      if (token === 'amount_with_comma_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2, '.', ',');
      if (token === 'amount_no_decimals_with_comma_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0, '.', ',');
      if (token === 'amount_with_apostrophe_separator') value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2, "'", '.');
      return format.replace(placeholder, value);
    }

    function updateSupport(cents) {
      if (typeof cents !== 'number') return;
      amount.textContent = formatMoney(Math.round(cents * 0.18), moneyFormat);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios').forEach((picker) => {
      picker.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (picker.currentVariant) updateSupport(picker.currentVariant.price);
      });
    });
  });
</script>


<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const accordions = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion__toggle');

    accordions.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const expanded = this.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !expanded);

        const content = this.nextElementSibling;
        content.classList.toggle('is-open', !expanded);
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<!-- Swiper JS CDN -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    initProductReviewSliders();

    // 1. Thumbnail Swiper Initialize
    var thumbSwiper = new Swiper('.productThumbSwiper', {
      spaceBetween: 8,
      slidesPerView: 'auto',
      freeMode: true,
      watchSlidesProgress: true,
    });

    // 2. Main Image Swiper Initialize (desktop nav arrows; hidden on mobile via CSS)
    var mainSwiperEl = document.querySelector('.productMainSwiper');
    var mainSwiper = mainSwiperEl
      ? new Swiper(mainSwiperEl, {
          spaceBetween: 10,
          navigation: {
            nextEl: mainSwiperEl.querySelector('.swiper-button-next'),
            prevEl: mainSwiperEl.querySelector('.swiper-button-prev'),
          },
          thumbs: {
            swiper: thumbSwiper,
          },
        })
      : null;

    function selectedProductValue(picker) {
      var selected = picker.querySelector(
        '[data-option-name="Choose Product"]:checked, [data-option-name="Product"]:checked'
      );
      return selected ? (selected.dataset.optionValue || selected.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function mediaIdForProductOption(picker) {
      var productValue = selectedProductValue(picker);
      if (!productValue) return null;

      var variant = picker.currentVariant;
      if (variant && variant.option1 === productValue && variant.featured_media && variant.featured_media.id) {
        return variant.featured_media.id;
      }

      var node = picker.querySelector('script[type="application/json"]:not([data-variant-formatted-prices])');
      if (!node) return null;

      var variants = [];
      try {
        variants = JSON.parse(node.textContent);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }

      var match = variants.find(function (item) {
        return item.option1 === productValue && item.featured_media && item.featured_media.id;
      });
      return match ? match.featured_media.id : null;
    }

    function showVariantOnMainSwiper(picker) {
      if (!mainSwiper) return;
      var mediaId = mediaIdForProductOption(picker);
      if (!mediaId) {
        mainSwiper.slideTo(0);
        return;
      }

      var index = Array.from(mainSwiper.slides).findIndex(function (slide) {
        return String(slide.dataset.mediaId) === String(mediaId);
      });
      if (index >= 0) mainSwiper.slideTo(index);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('variant-radios').forEach(function (picker) {
      picker.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
        var input = event.target;
        if (!input || !input.matches || !input.matches('input[type="radio"]')) return;
        var optionName = (input.dataset.optionName || '').trim();
        if (optionName !== 'Choose Product' && optionName !== 'Product') return;

        showVariantOnMainSwiper(picker);
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          showVariantOnMainSwiper(picker);
        }, 200);
      });
    });
  });

  function initProductReviewSliders(root) {
    var scope = root || document;
    scope.querySelectorAll('.product-review-slider').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.swiper || typeof Swiper === 'undefined') return;
      new Swiper(el, {
        slidesPerView: 1,
        spaceBetween: 12,
        loop: true,
        speed: 600,
        autoplay: {
          delay: 4500,
          disableOnInteraction: false,
          pauseOnMouseEnter: true,
        },
        pagination: {
          el: el.querySelector('.product-review-slider__pagination'),
          clickable: true,
        },
      });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') {
    initProductReviewSliders();
  }

  document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', function (event) {
    initProductReviewSliders(event.target);
  });
</script>



<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // If accordions are grouped inside a wrapper and you want the first per-wrapper:
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-accordion-wrapper').forEach(function (wrapper) {
      var first = wrapper.querySelector('.product__accordion.accordion.quick-add-hidden');
      if (first) first.classList.add('is-first-accordion');
    });

    // If there is no wrapper and you want the first on the whole page:
    var firstGlobal = document.querySelector('.product__accordion.accordion.quick-add-hidden');
    if (firstGlobal) firstGlobal.classList.add('is-first-accordion');
  });
</script>

<script>
  function updateVideoPoster() {
    document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function (video) {
      const mobilePoster = video.dataset.mobilePoster;
      const desktopPoster = video.getAttribute('poster');

      if (!mobilePoster) return;

      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        video.setAttribute('poster', mobilePoster);
      } else {
        // restore original desktop poster
        if (desktopPoster) {
          video.setAttribute('poster', desktopPoster);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateVideoPoster);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateVideoPoster);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', updateVideoPoster);
</script>


<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.product-video-list-section .video-wrapper');

  wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
    const video = wrapper.querySelector('video');
    const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector('.play-btn');

    const pauseAllOthers = () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.product-video-list-section video').forEach(v => {
        if (v !== video) {
          v.pause();
          v.controls = false;
          const btn = v.closest('.video-wrapper').querySelector('.play-btn');
          btn.style.display = 'flex';
        }
      });
    };

    playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      pauseAllOthers();
      video.muted = false;
      video.play();
      video.controls = true;
      playBtn.style.display = 'none';
    });

    video.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (video.paused) {
        pauseAllOthers();
        video.play();
        video.muted = false;
        video.controls = true;
        playBtn.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        video.pause();
        video.controls = false;
        playBtn.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    });

    video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
      playBtn.style.display = 'flex';
      video.controls = false;
      video.load();
    });
  });
});
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const section = document.querySelector('[data-section-id="template--22864827679028__hand_finished_edition_Q6pNPE"]');
    if (!section) return;

    const boxes = section.querySelectorAll('.hand-box');
    const image = section.querySelector('.hand-main-image');
    if (!image) return;

    let hoverTimeout = null;

    /**
    * Update responsive image correctly
    */
    const updateImage = (img, baseUrl) => {
      if (img.dataset.current === baseUrl) return;

      img.classList.add('is-changing');

      setTimeout(() => {
        img.src = `${baseUrl}&width=677&height=537&crop=center`;
        img.srcset = `
          ${baseUrl}&width=677&height=537&crop=center 677w
        `;
        img.sizes = '677px';
        img.dataset.current = baseUrl;

        img.classList.remove('is-changing');
      }, 200);
    };


    /**
    * Activate box
    */
    const activateBox = (box, followLink = false) => {
      boxes.forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });

      box.classList.add('active');
      box.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

      const baseImg = box.dataset.image;
      const link = box.dataset.link;

      if (baseImg) {
        updateImage(image, baseImg);
      }

      if (followLink && link) {
        window.location.href = link;
      }
    };

    boxes.forEach(box => {

      /* CLICK → select + optional link */
      box.addEventListener('click', () => {
        activateBox(box, true);
      });

      /* HOVER PREVIEW (DESKTOP ONLY) */
      box.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 900) return;

        clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
        hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          activateBox(box, false);
        }, 80);
      });

      /* KEYBOARD ACCESS */
      box.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          activateBox(box, true);
        }
      });

    });

  });
</script>

        show_product_name: "true",
        show_review_media: "true",
        no_image_fallback: "review_text_only",
        reviews_shown: "4",
      
    };
    const averageRating = 4.99;const params = {
      ...shared,
      star_rating: 'all',
      custom_tags: "",
      tag_filter: "",
      
      max_reviews: '20',
      url: 'https://www.albertlevi.com',
      shop_domain: 'fd9bda.myshopify.com',
      platform: 'shopify',
      primary_language: document.documentElement.lang,
      display_order: "media_first",
    };
    const blockId = "AUTh5bFFNQWhtSGZ0V__judge_me_reviews_cards_carousel_Jae7NT";
    function loadSpecificScript() {
      const scriptSrc = shared.carousel_type === 'videos' || shared.carousel_type === 'cards' ? 'https://cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a14416-995f-7951-a981-854ef92a0fd4/judgeme-786/assets/media_carousel.js' : 'https://cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a14416-995f-7951-a981-854ef92a0fd4/judgeme-786/assets/testimonials_carousel.js';
      // Already loaded (script tag) or in flight via loadJS from another carousel block — reuse it.
      window.jdgmCarouselScripts = window.jdgmCarouselScripts || {};
      if (window.jdgmCarouselScripts[scriptSrc] || document.querySelector(`script[src="${scriptSrc}"]`)) { initializeCarousel(); return; }
      // TT-1421: Cookiebot auto-blocking monkey-patches document.createElement and holds
      // dynamically-added <script> tags as text/plain, so a createElement-loaded carousel never
      // runs. jdgm.loadJS (XHR + Function eval, from judgeme_core) creates no <script> element and
      // slips past it — the same loader the main widget already uses. Fall back to a script tag
      // when Core isn't enabled and jdgm.loadJS is absent.
      if (window.jdgm && typeof window.jdgm.loadJS === 'function') {
        window.jdgmCarouselScripts[scriptSrc] = true;
        window.jdgm.loadJS(scriptSrc, function() { setTimeout(initializeCarousel, 50); });
      } else {
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = scriptSrc;
        script.onload = function() { setTimeout(initializeCarousel, 50); };
        script.onerror = function() { console.error('Error loading script:'); setTimeout(initializeCarousel, 100); };
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      }
    }

    function initializeCarousel() {
      if (!window.jdgmCarouselUtils || !window.jdgmCarouselMode) { setTimeout(initializeCarousel, 50); return; }
      const buildFunction = shared.carousel_type === 'videos' || shared.carousel_type === 'cards' ? window.jdgmBuildMediaCards : window.jdgmBuildTestimonialCards;
      if (buildFunction) {
        const start = function() { window.jdgmCarouselUtils.initCarousel(blockId, settings, averageRating, params, buildFunction); };
          start();
      } else {
        setTimeout(initializeCarousel, 100);
      }
    }
    loadSpecificScript();
  })();
</script>
<!-- END app snippet -->

<script>
(function () {
  if (!window.matchMedia('(max-width: 749px)').matches) return;

  const track = document.querySelector('.canvas-features-grid');
  if (!track) return;

  // If you want fully native behavior, you can comment out the JS below.
  // The JS below only snaps once user scrolling settles (debounced on scroll).
  let scrollEndTimer = null;
  const SCROLL_END_DEBOUNCE = 120; // ms - small delay to detect scroll-ended

  function snapToNearest() {
    const children = Array.from(track.children);
    if (!children.length) return;

    // compute slide left positions relative to the track
    const positions = children.map((slide) => slide.offsetLeft);

    const current = track.scrollLeft;

    // find nearest position
    let nearest = positions.reduce((prev, pos) =>
      Math.abs(pos - current) < Math.abs(prev - current) ? pos : prev
    );

    // only animate if we are more than a few pixels away to avoid micro-snaps
    if (Math.abs(nearest - current) > 4) {
      // smooth scroll to the nearest slide
      track.scrollTo({ left: nearest, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }

  // Debounced scroll-end detection — fires when native momentum stops
  function onScroll() {
    if (scrollEndTimer) clearTimeout(scrollEndTimer);
    scrollEndTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      snapToNearest();
      scrollEndTimer = null;
    }, SCROLL_END_DEBOUNCE);
  }

  // If user starts interacting while JS is animating, cancel the animation smoothly
  function onPointerDown() {
    if (scrollEndTimer) { clearTimeout(scrollEndTimer); scrollEndTimer = null; }
    // Cancel any in-progress smooth scroll by setting behavior auto (small trick):
    try { track.scrollTo({ left: track.scrollLeft, behavior: 'auto' }); } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Use passive listeners for scroll for perf; pointer/touch listeners as needed
  track.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  track.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: true });
  track.addEventListener('touchstart', onPointerDown, { passive: true });

  // Optional fallback: also snap on resize (in case widths changed)
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    // small timeout so layout stabilizes
    setTimeout(() => { snapToNearest(); }, 120);
  });

})();
</script>

  <script>
    (function () {
      var section = document.querySelector('[data-section-id="template--22864827679028__related-products"]');
      if (!section || section.dataset.relatedSliderReady === "true") return;
      section.dataset.relatedSliderReady = "true";

      function initSlider() {
        var track = section.querySelector("#RelatedTrack-template--22864827679028__related-products");
        if (!track || typeof Swiper === "undefined") return false;
        if (track.swiper) return true;

        new Swiper(track, {
          slidesPerView: "auto",
          spaceBetween: 24,
          grabCursor: true,
          simulateTouch: true,
          allowTouchMove: true,
          threshold: 6,
          watchOverflow: true,
          freeMode: {
            enabled: true,
            momentum: true,
            momentumRatio: 0.6
          },
          mousewheel: {
            enabled: true,
            forceToAxis: true,
            releaseOnEdges: true
          },
          navigation: {
            prevEl: section.querySelector('[data-slide-dir="left"]'),
            nextEl: section.querySelector('[data-slide-dir="right"]')
          }
        });
        return true;
      }

      var booting = false;
      function boot() {
        if (initSlider() || booting) return;
        booting = true;
        var tries = 0;
        var timer = setInterval(function () {
          tries += 1;
          if (initSlider() || tries > 25) {
            clearInterval(timer);
            booting = false;
          }
        }, 200);
      }

      boot();
      new MutationObserver(boot).observe(section, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    })();
  </script>

</div>




</section>

    <script>
      /**
       * Form & Thank You Modal - Scoped to closest container
       * Handles both: .ctm-form_main (standalone form) and .gallery_product_modal_overlay (gallery modal form)
       * Each form only affects its own thank you modal - no conflicts when multiple forms on same page.
       */
      document.addEventListener('globo.formbuilder.form.submitted', function (e) {
        var submittedForm = e.detail.form;
        if (!submittedForm) return;

        var container = submittedForm.closest('.gallery_product_modal_overlay, .ctm-form_main');
         // added here by yash
        var name = submittedForm.querySelector('[name="name-1"]')?.value || '';
        var email = submittedForm.querySelector('[name="email-1"]')?.value || '';
          loadCalendly({name,email});
        if (container) {
          container.classList.add('form-submitted');
        }
      });

       // this is added by yash on 2nd april 2026
      function loadCalendly(data) {
       
        const container = document.querySelector('.calendly-inline-widget');
        if (!container) return;

        const params = new URLSearchParams({
          name: data.name,
          email: data.email,
          hide_gdpr_banner: "1"
        });

        const url = "https://calendly.com/fineart-albertlevi/30min?" + params.toString();

        container.innerHTML = "";

        if (window.Calendly) {
          Calendly.initInlineWidget({
            url: url,
            parentElement: container
          });
        }
      }
      //end here

      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var closeBtn = e.target.closest('.thank_you_close, .gallery_product_modal_close');
        if (!closeBtn) return;

        var container = closeBtn.closest('.ctm-form_main') || closeBtn.closest('.gallery_product_modal_overlay');
        if (container) {
          container.classList.remove('form-submitted');
        }
      });

        let i = new Date;
        i.setTime(i.getTime() + 24 * o * 36e5 + 60 * n * 1e3);
        let f = "expires=" + i.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = e + "=" + t + ";" + f + (r ? ";path=" + r : ";path=/");
    };
    SECOMAPP.deleteCookie = function (e, t) {
        document.cookie = e + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; " + (t ? ";path=" + t : ";path=/")
    };
    SECOMAPP.getCookie = function (e) {
        for (let t = e + "=", o = document.cookie.split(";"), n = 0; n < o.length; n++) {
            let r;
            for (r = o[n]; " " === r.charAt(0);) r = r.substring(1);
            if (0 === r.indexOf(t)) return r.substring(t.length, r.length)
        }
        return ""
    };
    SECOMAPP.getQueryString = function (key) {
        let e = {};
        let t = window.location.search.substring(1).split("&");
        let o = 0;
        for (; o < t.length; o++) {
            let n = t[o].split("=");
            if (void 0 === e[n[0]]) e[n[0]] = decodeURIComponent(n[1]);
            else if ("string" == typeof e[n[0]]) {
                e[n[0]] = [e[n[0]], decodeURIComponent(n[1])]
            } else e[n[0]].push(decodeURIComponent(n[1]))
        }
        return key ? e[key] : e;
    };

<style>
@media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
  .product-card-wrapper {
    position: relative;
  }

  .product-card-wrapper img:nth-of-type(1) {
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  .product-card-wrapper img:nth-of-type(2) {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .product-card-wrapper.hovering img:nth-of-type(1) {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .product-card-wrapper.hovering img:nth-of-type(2) {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.product-card-wrapper');

  cards.forEach(function (card) {
    card.addEventListener("touchstart", function () {
      card.classList.add("hovering");
    });

    card.addEventListener("touchend", function () {
      card.classList.remove("hovering");
    });

    card.addEventListener("touchcancel", function () {
      card.classList.remove("hovering");
    });
  });
});
</script>
